meta.title: Ammar Albakri — Robotics Software Engineer
meta.description: Ammar Albakri is a robotics software engineer and software team leader focused on autonomous mobile robots, navigation, and engineering software.

profile.name: Ammar Albakri
headline: Robotics software
engineer.
profile.introduction: I build software for robots and engineering teams. My background spans autonomous mobile robots, ROS-based navigation, simulation, and business applications, backed by a foundation in computer architecture, algorithms, and programming languages.

experience.title: Work experience
experience.intro: From building robot capabilities to leading software delivery, I work across the full engineering lifecycle.

roles.title: Technical Consultant
roles.summary: Develop customer-specific ERP customizations with Python and the Odoo framework, while translating business requirements into practical solutions with minimal complexity.
highlights: Analyze customer requirements and recommend clear, maintainable approaches to meet their business needs.
Develop and customize Odoo ERP functionality using Python and Odoo's framework.

roles.title: Software Team Leader
roles.summary: Led a software team of 4–6 engineers across mobile robotics, web applications, and desktop applications, while contributing directly to development and code reviews.
highlights: Guided multiple projects from planning through delivery, with a focus on timelines, quality, and client expectations.
Introduced more efficient project-management practices to improve productivity and streamline workflows.
Mentored engineers, supported a collaborative team environment, and reported project progress to management.

roles.title: Robotics Software Engineer
roles.summary: Developed software for robotic platforms, integrating sensors and implementing navigation capabilities across real robots and simulation.
highlights: Built real-time robotics software and integrated ROS packages to connect software and hardware components.
Worked with SLAM, pathfinding, and magnetic line-following algorithms for autonomous navigation.
Used Gazebo for simulation-based testing and RViz for visualization, debugging, and analysis.
Contributed to electrical and mechanical design discussions to improve system performance.

roles.title: R&D Software Engineer
roles.summary: Maintained and extended an ERP system, developing business modules and supporting its database, testing, and ongoing operation.
highlights: Developed MRP (Material Resource Planning) and warehouse-tracking modules.
Analyzed requirements, proposed features, implemented UI improvements, and fixed software defects.
Performed unit and system testing, maintained the database, and conducted code reviews.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Robotics projects spanning autonomous navigation, material handling, fleet operation, and enterprise software.

items.name: Autonomous mobile robot (AMR)
items.imageAlt: Illustration of an autonomous mobile robot
items.summary: A load-bearing mobile robot designed to support warehouse and logistics operations.
highlights: Operators can dispatch tasks and monitor progress through a web panel.
Supports fleet operation using traffic-management rules and a fleet-management system.

items.name: Automated guided vehicle (AGV)
items.imageAlt: Illustration of an automated guided vehicle
items.summary: Epik Robotik’s first manufactured robot, demonstrating mobile maneuvering and lifting capabilities.
highlights: Uses magnetic line tracking to follow its route.
Reads QR codes to determine position and plan its next movement.

items.name: Autonomous transpallet robot
items.imageAlt: Illustration of an autonomous transpallet robot
items.summary: An autonomous pallet-handling robot with accurate placement, pallet detection, and multi-sensor safety.
highlights: Uses QR alignment for accurate pallet placement.
Detects different pallet types and makes self-correcting maneuvers.
Provides 360-degree safety monitoring with LiDAR, 3D cameras, and ultrasonic sensors.

items.name: ERP system modules
items.summary: Business software development and maintenance, including resource-planning and warehouse operations.
highlights: Developed modules for material planning and warehouse tracking.
Contributed UI, database, testing, maintenance, and feature work.

items.name: Odoo ERP customization
items.summary: Customer-specific Odoo ERP development that maps business requirements to practical, maintainable workflows.
highlights: Analyze customer requirements and design solutions with minimal unnecessary complexity.
Develop tailored ERP customizations using Python and Odoo's framework.

education.heading: Education
details: Graduated with a GPA of 3.73 / 4.00 and ranked first in the engineering faculty.
Completed two semesters of a double major in Electrical-Electronic Engineering.
